args.question: Acme Supplies (V-628) has TWO approved invoices: INV-37191 for $3,551.99 (due 2026-11-25) and INV-45131 for $6,853.44 (due 2026-11-04). No payments have been sent yet. Which one should I pay by wire, or should I pay both?

trace.question: Acme Supplies (V-628) has TWO approved invoices: INV-37191 for $3,551.99 (due 2026-11-25) and INV-45131 for $6,853.44 (due 2026-11-04). No payments have been sent yet. Which one should I pay by wire, or should I pay both?

trace.message: Pay INV-37191, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Acme Supplies' invoice INV-37191 in full by wire: payment PAY0001, $3,551.99 from the operating account. The status is "sent" and it was paid once.

- **Why this invoice:** Acme had two approved invoices. You told me to pay INV-37191 (due 2026-11-25). I didn't pay INV-45131 ($6,853.44, due 2026-11-04) because you said it's under dispute.
- **Approval:** The payment is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.
- **Duplicate check:** Before paying, I confirmed no payments had already gone out. I also sent the wire with an idempotency key (a tag that stops the same payment going out twice).

INV-78192 ($4,269.77) is still a draft awaiting approval, so I didn't pay it.
